full_prompt_en: A square architectural photograph looks straight down a narrow reflecting basin toward a monumental set of concentric brick arches. The basin begins at the lower edge, bordered by low gray stone sides and a sequence of shallow transverse ledges. Its water is dark and smooth enough to reflect the arch, gray sky, and bordering walls in broken vertical bands. At the far end, repeated semicircular brick vaults recede one inside another, shrinking toward a small, bright round opening at the exact center. A dark figure-like form or pedestal sits beneath that opening. Above the arches rises a pale stone triangular gable with horizontal courses, its apex near the top center. Tall gray walls flank the scene on both sides, enclosing the approach and strengthening its symmetry. A few thin dark tree shapes stand against the side walls. The brick ranges from muted terracotta to deep brown inside the tunnels, while the larger walls and paving are cool gray. The daylight is soft and high, leaving the exterior evenly lit and allowing each nested arch to grow darker with depth. Fine stone joints and brick courses remain visible; the water adds a glossy countertexture to the matte masonry. The low frontal camera position aligns every central element: the basin, series of arches, and circular light at the back. The composition is severely symmetrical yet optically deep, using repeated curved openings and a reflecting axis to turn heavy materials into a quiet visual tunnel.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形建筑照片沿狭窄反光水池正面望向一组宏大的同心砖拱。水池从下边缘开始，两侧有低矮灰石边和一串浅浅横向台阶。水面深暗且足够平滑，把拱、灰天和两侧墙体反成断续竖向色带。远端，半圆砖拱一个套着一个向内后退，逐渐缩向正中央的小亮圆开口。开口下方有一处深色人物般轮廓或基座。拱顶上方升起横向砌层可见的浅石三角山墙，尖端靠近画面顶部中央。高灰墙从两侧夹住场景，围合通路并增强对称感。几棵细瘦深色树形贴在侧墙前。砖色从柔赤陶转为隧道内部深棕，大墙和铺地则是冷灰。日光柔和且从高处来，外部受光均匀，每道套拱随着纵深加深。细石缝与砖层仍可见；水面为哑光砌体增加发亮的对照质感。低位正面机位把水池、拱列和后端圆光全部对齐。构图严格对称，却有光学纵深，借重复曲线开口和反光轴线把厚重材料转为安静的视觉隧道。
style_prompt_en: Photography uses rigorous frontal symmetry, repeated nested curves, and one centered reflective axis to create deep visual recession. Combine warm terracotta or brown bands with large cool gray planes, letting shadow progressively darken each inner layer. Soft high daylight preserves material joints, horizontal courses, and matte grain without harsh exterior contrast. A narrow glossy strip below can mirror the repeated geometry and add broken vertical highlights. Keep side areas heavy and quiet so a small distant bright aperture acts as the destination of the view. A low camera position strengthens the alignment of near edges and far opening. The transferable effect is solemn and measured, built from rhythmic enclosure, warm-cool mass, depth by repetition, and restrained reflection.
style_prompt_zh: 摄影以严格正面对称、重复套叠曲线和一条居中反光轴线制造深远退缩感。暖赤陶或棕色带与大块冷灰平面相配，让每层内部的阴影逐渐加深。柔和高位日光保留材料接缝、水平层理和哑光颗粒，而不使外部反差过硬。下方一道窄亮面可映照重复几何，并添加断续竖亮痕。两侧区域厚重而安静，使远处小亮开口成为视线终点。低机位强化近边与远处开口的对齐。可迁移的效果庄重、有分寸，来自有节奏的围合、冷暖体量、重复产生的纵深和克制倒影。
theme_en: Concentric brick arches frame a circular opening across a reflecting basin
theme_zh: 同心砖拱隔着反光水池框住圆形开口
name: Mario Botta
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
